heading: What we stand for.
sub: A child ends a term with marks and a body of work.

items.title: Think first.
items.detail: The pencil and the clear sentence precede the code and the terminal prompt.

items.title: Marks and a body of work.
items.detail: We secure marks first to open gates, then build the real portfolio on top.

items.title: Honesty.
items.detail: No faked outcomes, no vanity certificates, no inflated promises.

items.title: Safety and dignity.
items.detail: A quiet, respectful study environment for women, adolescents, and older citizens alike.

items.title: Everyone teaches.
items.detail: You do not truly understand a concept until you can teach it to someone else.

items.title: Local first.
items.detail: District youth should not have to leave their family home to access serious mentorship.

items.title: Open doors.
items.detail: A reader or retired citizen has equal right to the building as an exam student.

items.title: No hype.
items.detail: We build with stone, wood, books, and disciplined code. Not temporary digital fads.

boundary.label: Negative Space · What Synapse is not
boundary.text: Not a coaching mill, not a software app with a classroom attached, and not an accelerator that sells equity to speculators.
